title: All beautiful!!!
text:
Very nice trip!!
It is worth it!!!
Nice bus!!
All very attentive!!!
The only other way, they shouldn't make groups for 2 languages. As our group was only 2 people in Spanish and the rest in English, we felt left in the background. Since the most attention was to the group in English. 
You lost a little the charm of understanding the right team.  
I would no longer agree to take a tour with 2 languages.

title: Travel with the best to Granada
text:
Alex and Pablo our guide in Granada are spectacular.
This tour is highly recommended. You can't miss it. Pablo has a great knowledge of history and shows everything in the Alhambra in detail.
It is the best investment, if you want to know.

title: Fabulous trip to Granada!
text: It was an amazing trip! Dris, our tour guide was fantastic, entertaining, and knowledgeable. Our driver Miguel drove us there in a large comfortable coach. We made one stop to grab snacks both ways. Truly recommend this excursion and company.
